answer: A clone farm dies at the gate if every agent may keep only one sounding stone on the north inlet of Red Canyon and must prove that stone rode a measured gale. The applicant locks 51 coins for 21 days, seats stone S-14 in a socket cut at intake, and files a ten-minute wind trace when the official gale siren sounds. Peers attest only if the canyon register lists S-14 once, bound to that agent, and the inlet anemometer hash matches the filed trace. A second stone, a borrowed socket, or a spliced trace forfeits the lock and returns S-14 to auction.
